component.name: Addict

description.p: Addict is a hotkey translator for readers of English, Spanish, Catalan and Russian. Choose your own language, the language of translation, in Settings; the other three are the languages you read. Select or copy a word or a sentence anywhere, press the shortcut, and a small window shows the dictionary article of the word: its senses, synonyms, transcriptions with recordings, and its translations into your language.

ul.li: A clipboard shortcut reads the selected text, or the clipboard when nothing is selected, the same way in every application
Your language is English, Spanish, Catalan or Russian, chosen in Settings, with US or British spelling for English
Offline dictionary lookup in English, Spanish and Catalan, by the word as written and by its dictionary forms
Online translations into your language with a DeepL API key, between any two of the four languages, of the clicked word in the context of its sentence and of the sentence itself
Offline translations from the dictionaries between Russian and English, Spanish or Catalan, and English glosses of Spanish and Catalan words
A separate screenshot shortcut opens a region picker to read text in an image or a video with Tesseract OCR; assign its key in Settings
Normal launches show the main window, with Settings available directly; use --background for a silent login launch
A Russian word is translated into your language, or, with Russian as your language, into the reading language
